ConversionReadiness.Summary: 3BA currently fits the experimental/manual-cleanup tier: conversion can proceed=False, physics-ready=True, safe-animation=False, skeleton reliability=provisional, remap safety=unsafe, target-body support=direct.

Caveats: Radically different topology can still need manual Outfit Studio cleanup before release.
Extreme oral/genital/alien/custom appendage meshes remain the highest-risk automatic conversion path.
Generated validation guidance improves review for 3BA, but it is not a substitute for real in-game/runtime checks.
LimitationNotes: Runtime validation now exports a machine-readable external harness contract so preflight and scenario dispatch can be automated outside the app.
A real live-game pass still requires an external harness or scripted test environment in the final modded game install.
Blocking runtime probes still require host-side observation or assertion capture on the final skeleton, body, and load-order combination.
